# Green Giant Multiverse

> Expanding Your Universe, Transforming Your Vision. Worldwide creative agency offering professional visual systems for growing businesses.

## About
Green Giant Multiverse is a worldwide graphic design and branding agency founded by Wisdom Samuel, based in Port Harcourt, Nigeria. We have delivered 200+ design assets across 20+ brands. Specialist in production-ready design that works in real-world print and digital.

Founder: Wisdom Samuel
Slogan: Expanding Your Universe, Transforming Your Vision
Experience: 3+ Years of Industrial Experienc

## Services - Worldwide
- Brand Identity Design: Logo design, brand guidelines, visual systems
- Visual & Graphic Design: Clean, professional visuals for digital and print
- Marketing Design: Flyers, social media graphics, campaign assets
- Print Production: Production-ready files built for printing press environments
- Social Media Graphics: Consistent templates that strengthen online presence
- Packaging & Apparel: Product packaging, labels and apparel graphics
- Company Profile Design: Professional company profiles that build trust
- Web Design & Creative Solutions: Complete visual solutions
